name: EG-58
description: EG-58 was a white-plated GNK-series power droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton. In 34 ABY, during the First Order's occupation of the planet Batuu, EG-58 was part of the Resistance forces stationed in Black Spire Outpost on the world. The power droid worked at Resistance Supply, where it stood with fellow droid EG-57 storing power for the Resistance next to a short-range antenna near the stall.
